full_prompt_en: A square close photograph shows a hand holding a fine brush to a grayscale profile drawing on white textured paper. The drawn subject is a young woman facing left, her head and upper neck occupying the center and left of the page. Dark hair gathers behind her face and breaks apart into dry granular marks at the upper right, where the white paper remains visible through it. Her eyebrow, eye, nose, lips, and chin are carefully modeled in soft gray, while the outer edge of the hair is intentionally unfinished. The actual hand enters from the lower-left edge, with fingers wrapped around a slim dark handle and the tiny brush tip touching the drawn nose. Its warm natural skin tone contrasts with the almost monochrome image on the paper. Around the face, loose scratches, rubbed charcoal-like dust, and pale construction lines show the drawing in progress. The paper itself fills the background, with faint fibers and gray smudges but no frame or readable writing. The eye and nose are the sharpest features; the hair and shoulder dissolve into a loose cloud of broken dark marks. Soft light comes from the upper left, brightening the hand and paper while the drawn shadows remain the source of facial volume. A shallow camera angle keeps the page nearly flat in the frame, yet the real fingers and brush sit visibly above the surface. The overall composition contrasts precise human likeness with powdery unfinished edges and the intimate act of making.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形近景照片描绘一只手拿细画笔，在白色粗纹纸上的灰阶侧面素描上加工。画中主体是一名朝左的年轻女子，头与上颈占据纸面中央和左侧。深发聚在面后，在右上方破裂为干燥颗粒笔痕，白纸从其间透出。她的眉、眼、鼻、唇和下巴以柔灰仔细塑形，头发外缘则有意保留未完成。真实的手从左下缘进入，手指握着细深色笔杆，微小笔尖触在画中鼻部。其温暖自然肤色与纸上几乎单色的图像形成对比。面部周围的松散划痕、擦开的似炭粉尘和浅起稿线表明画还在制作。纸面填满背景，有淡纤维和灰污痕，却没有画框或可读书写。眼和鼻是最清楚的特征；头发与肩部消融成破碎深色笔痕的松云。柔光从左上方进入，照亮手与纸，画出的阴影则成为面部体积来源。浅摄影角度让纸页在画幅里几乎平坦，但真实手指与画笔明显位于表面之上。整体构图以精确的人物形象对照粉状未完成边缘和亲密的制作动作。
style_prompt_en: The image has a dry-brush and charcoal-like drawing finish on fibrous paper, with powdery deposits, rubbed gray transitions, and sharply selective detail. Black, graphite, silver gray, and bare white make the value structure; a small warm material accent may sit outside the drawing plane. Fine strokes concentrate in the focal area, while dark masses fragment into stippling, dust, and unfinished construction lines toward the margins. Soft ambient light keeps paper fibers visible and leaves the darkest drawn passages matte rather than glossy. Precisely modeled contours coexist with rough erased edges, creating depth through both line density and tonal rubbing. Generous pale space balances the dense central texture. The overall effect is immediate, tactile, and meticulously observed.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有纤维纸上的干刷与似炭笔素描质感，带粉状沉积、擦开的灰阶过渡和选择性极清楚的细节。黑、石墨、银灰与裸白构成明度结构；一处小小暖材料强调可位于素描平面之外。细笔触聚在焦点区域，深色团块向边缘碎成点纹、粉尘和未完成起稿线。柔环境光保持纸纤维可见，最深的画出区域仍哑光而非光亮。精确塑造的轮廓与粗糙擦去的边缘并存，通过线条密度和色调摩擦共同建立纵深。宽裕浅色空间平衡中央密集肌理。整体效果即时、可触且观察缜密。
theme_en: A hand refining a grayscale profile drawing on textured paper
theme_zh: 在粗纹纸上细修灰阶侧面素描的一只手
name: Dry brush drawing
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
